sentences.text: The petitioner was working as a Junior Telecom Officer in the Department of Telecommunications.
Some allegations were levelled regarding the improper measurement of the depth of the tranches in the measurement book.
Accordingly, FIR No.14/1997 was registered on 19.07.1997 under Sections 420, 120-B and 218 of the IPC.
The petitioner was not initially named in the FIR but his name surfaced subsequently after ten years.
Though the charge sheet was filed in the aforesaid case in the year 2007 but till date, that is, for 27, years charges have not been framed.
3. It is in this background that the petitioner applied for the quashing of the FIR which has been refused by the High Court.
4. The submission is that keeping the matter pending for 27 years without framing charges is a gross abuse of process of law.
5. Issue notice, returnable in six weeks.
(Nidhi Mathur) (Geeta Ahuja)
